# Mohammad Ali Jesar (mjesar)

> Senior software engineer specializing in AI automation, with Ruby on Rails as the core stack, based in Lahore, Pakistan, with 7+ years of production Rails experience for clients in the US and Germany, 4+ of them on Shopify and e-commerce. Helps startups launch MVPs and SaaS applications, builds new Rails apps, works on existing Rails apps, adds AI features (LLM integrations, MCP servers, RAG with pgvector, AI agents) inside Rails, and builds Shopify and BigCommerce apps and integrations. Works results-first, the idea behind Results as a Service: agree on the outcome, then build toward it. Open to remote full-time roles, contracts and project work.

Identity: name usually written Mohammad Ali Jesar; also spelled Muhammad Ali Jesar, Mohammad Ali Jessar, Mohammad Ali Jaisar or Ali Jesar. Online handle mjesar (the same on GitHub, GitLab, LinkedIn and Fiverr). Holds a B.S. in Information Technology (Software), 2017. Languages: English (professional working proficiency). Available now. Based in Lahore, Pakistan (UTC+5) with flexible hours: adapts to the client's time zone, including U.S. and European business hours.

Roles and search terms: Senior Software Engineer, AI automation engineer, Ruby on Rails engineer or developer, AI engineer, full-stack engineer, Shopify app developer, BigCommerce app developer, MCP developer.

Industries: e-commerce and retail (US merchants), SaaS (Shopify and BigCommerce apps), real estate and furniture (German clients).

Terms: MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG (retrieval-augmented generation), GEO (generative engine optimization), AEO (answer engine optimization), LLM (large language model).

## Skills

- Rails and web: Ruby on Rails, Hotwire (Turbo, Stimulus), React, JavaScript, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Sidekiq, Solid Queue, REST and GraphQL APIs, RSpec, Heroku, AWS, Google Cloud, Docker.
- Shopify and e-commerce: Polaris, App Bridge, Admin and Storefront APIs (REST and GraphQL), webhooks, Shopify Functions (including migrations from Shopify Scripts), Checkout UI Extensions, Checkout Extensibility, Shopify Plus B2B, Theme App Extensions, Liquid, App Store publishing, BigCommerce apps, Amazon SP-API.
- AI: agentic AI, workflow and business process automation (n8n or code), LLM integrations (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, RubyLLM), MCP servers and an MCP client, WebMCP tools for browser AI agents, RAG with pgvector on PostgreSQL, AI agents with tool calling, evals.
- AI-assisted development: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude and ChatGPT for coding, research, review and documentation, with my own review, tests and ownership of every change.
- AI discoverability (GEO and AEO), as an independent senior AEO and GEO specialist: helping online stores and brands get found and described correctly by ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI. Audits of AI crawler access, product content, FAQ coverage and schema.org structured data for Shopify, BigCommerce and other online stores, and brand AI visibility (how AI assistants describe a brand, consistent brand facts, Organization structured data), with fixes and a before-and-after re-check of buyer questions.
- Ways of working: agile teams with sprint planning, backlog grooming, scoping and task estimation; small, reviewable pull requests with tests.

## How I work (results-first)

Results-first, the idea behind Results as a Service: focus on what the software needs to accomplish, not just the features delivered.

1. Agree on the outcome, for example an MVP live with users, a manual process automated, or an integration that runs without manual fixes.
2. Measure the starting point.
3. Define the scope and build toward the outcome in small, reviewable steps with tests.
4. Check the result against the agreed outcome.

Pricing is monthly, hourly or fixed price (see below).

## AI discoverability plans (USD)

One-off plans, one store or one brand each, with no long contract. No plan guarantees rankings, citations or AI recommendations. My own tools are included; optional tracking subscriptions stay in the client's own account, with no markup.

## This website as an AI visibility example

This site applies the same AI discoverability practices offered as a service: Person, Service, FAQPage, SoftwareSourceCode and BreadcrumbList structured data, consistent identity facts linked across the website and GitHub profile, answer-first FAQ content, and this llms.txt file generated from the same data as the site.
